subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n artifacts, and saved preferences?
rationale: The source change is technically bounded, but the choice changes user-facing locale values, documented env usage, generated artifact names, and persisted browser state, so automation should not pick the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate all runtime, docs, generator, test, and saved-preference surfaces together with explicit compatibility handling.

options.title: Keep region IDs stable
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's public locale contract and keep improving terminology under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep this issue open as backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization and docs-publish shape.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate all runtime, docs, generator, test, and saved-preference surfaces together with explicit compatibility handling.
